title: Staircase
description: A slide from 60,427 to 54,386 in five downswings: lows at 59,544, 58,540, 57,630, 57,219 and 57,042, each bounced from and then closed below. On 4 Jul 15:00 price closes at 58,100, above the bounce high of the third swing (57,900): a bullish market structure break. The next low still breaks lower, so the downswings continue.
